---
title: "04 Annotation validation"
output: html_document
params:
  run_singler: false
---

Independent checks on the assigned cell-type labels from notebook 03 include:
1. Coverage (resolved vs unresolved).
2. Enrichment of the scoring markers in their assigned class (one-sided Wilcoxon, BH).
3. Concordance with a held-out marker panel that shares no genes with the annotation.
4. Association of scores with sequencing depth
5. Agreement with three external references via SingleR (Siletti 2023 adult
   human brain; a developing human brain reference; Allen Smart-seq2 MTG).
    - This step is compute intensive and was performed on the cluster
    - Analysis included in the notebook uses precomputed predictions deposited on Zenodo 
    - To rerun SingleR on the reference objects listed in `config/paths.example.yaml`, set `run_singler = TRUE`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(Matrix)
})
source(file.path("..", "R", "helpers.R"))
paths <- load_paths()
```

## Parameters

```{r parameters}
qc_unresolved  <- c("Unknown", "Neuron_unresolved", "NonNeuron_unresolved")
ann_unresolved <- c("Neuron_unresolved", "NonNeuron_unresolved")

# Marker enrichment
pseudocount <- 0.1
fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
min_cells_per_side <- 3L

# Held-out panel (must not overlap annotation genes)
heldout_panel <- list(
  Neuron_core = c("CORO6", "SLC12A5"),
  Excitatory_neurons = c("CBLN2", "CAMK2A"),
  Inhibitory_neurons = c("GABRB2", "GRIK2"),
  Oligodendrocytes = c("UGT8", "MAL"),
  OPCs = c("BCAN"),
  Astrocytes = c("FGFR3", "AGT"),
  Microglia = c("DOCK8", "PTPRC"),
  Pericytes = c("GUCY1A2", "COLEC12"),
  Endothelial = c("FMO2", "LAMA5"))

heldout_min_cells_per_class <- 2L

# SingleR
canonical_classes <- c("Excitatory_neurons", "Inhibitory_neurons", "Astrocytes", "OPCs",
                       "Oligodendrocytes", "Microglia", "Endothelial", "Pericytes")

out_of_scope_labels   <- c("neural_progenitor", "smooth_muscle_cell")

gene_exclude_patterns <- c("^MT-", "^RPL", "^RPS")
prune_nmads <- 3L

references <- list(
  siletti = list(path = paths$ref_siletti, subset_field = "data_type",
                       subset_value = "siletti", label_field = "cluster_annotation"),
  developmental = list(path = paths$ref_developmental, subset_field = "data_type",
                       subset_value = "dev", label_field = "cluster_annotation"),
  ss2 = list(path = paths$ref_ss2, subset_field = NA, subset_value = NA,
                       label_field = "subclass_label"))
```

```{r load}

sce <- readRDS(file.path(paths$work_dir, "03_annotated.rds"))
per_cell <- read.delim(file.path(paths$work_dir, "03_annotation_per_cell.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

stopifnot(identical(per_cell$cell_id, colnames(sce)))
final <- per_cell$final_celltype_label
log_sym <- symbol_matrices(sce, "symbol")$logcounts
is_res <- !(final %in% qc_unresolved)

# Scoring markers and EX/IN genes saved by notebook 03

markers <- readRDS(file.path(paths$work_dir, "03_marker_lists.rds"))
known_list_syms <- markers$known_list_syms

annotation_used_genes <- unique(c(unlist(known_list_syms), unlist(markers$exin_evidence)))
```

## 1. Coverage

```{r coverage}
coverage <- data.frame(
  metric = c("n_total", "n_resolved", "n_unresolved", "fraction_resolved", "fraction_unresolved"),
  value  = c(length(final), sum(is_res), sum(!is_res), mean(is_res), mean(!is_res)))
coverage
table(final_label = final)
```

## 2. Scoring-marker enrichment

For each class and each of its markers: a one-sided Wilcoxon test comparing
resolved nuclei of that class against all other resolved nuclei, with BH
correction within the class. A marker is enriched when FDR < 0.05 and
log2FC > 0.

```{r enrichment}
enrichment <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(known_list_syms), function(ct) {
  markers <- intersect(known_list_syms[[ct]], rownames(log_sym))
  in_cl  <- which(final == ct & is_res)
  out_cl <- which(final != ct & is_res)
  if (length(markers) == 0L || length(in_cl) < min_cells_per_side ||
      length(out_cl) < min_cells_per_side) return(NULL)
  rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(markers, function(g) {
    xi <- as.numeric(log_sym[g, in_cl]); xo <- as.numeric(log_sym[g, out_cl])
    wt <- suppressWarnings(stats::wilcox.test(xi, xo, alternative = "greater"))
    data.frame(cell_class = ct, gene = g, n_in = length(in_cl), n_out = length(out_cl),
               mean_in = mean(xi), mean_out = mean(xo),
               log2FC = log2((mean(xi) + pseudocount) / (mean(xo) + pseudocount)),
               p_value = wt$p.value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  rows$FDR <- stats::p.adjust(rows$p_value, method = "BH")
  rows$enriched <- rows$FDR < fdr_cutoff & rows$log2FC > 0
  rows
}))
aggregate(enriched ~ cell_class, data = enrichment, FUN = mean)
```

## 3. Held-out marker panel

For each held-out gene, median logcounts are compared across resolved
classes, using only classes with at least 2 nuclei. The gene validates its
expected class when that class has the unique highest median.

```{r heldout}

stopifnot(length(intersect(unlist(heldout_panel), annotation_used_genes)) == 0L)
class_labs <- setdiff(unique(final[is_res]), qc_unresolved)

heldout <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(heldout_panel), function(ct) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(heldout_panel[[ct]], function(g) {
    status <- "missing_gene"; maxers <- NA_character_
    if (g %in% rownames(log_sym)) {
      med <- vapply(class_labs, function(k) {
        idx <- which(final == k & is_res)
        if (length(idx) < heldout_min_cells_per_class) return(NA_real_)
        stats::median(as.numeric(log_sym[g, idx]))
      }, numeric(1))
      med <- med[!is.na(med)]
      if (length(med) == 0L || !(ct %in% names(med))) {
        status <- "insufficient_class_support"
      } else {
        maxers <- names(med)[med == max(med)]
        status <- if (length(maxers) > 1L) "tie_for_max" else
          if (identical(maxers, ct)) "correct_unique_max" else "incorrect_unique_max"
        maxers <- paste(maxers, collapse = ";")
      }
    }
    data.frame(expected_class = ct, gene = g, maximizing_classes = maxers,
               validation_status = status, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}))

heldout_per_class <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(heldout, heldout$expected_class), function(df) {
  ev <- df$validation_status %in% c("correct_unique_max", "incorrect_unique_max", "tie_for_max")
  data.frame(cell_class = df$expected_class[1], n_evaluable = sum(ev),
             n_correct = sum(df$validation_status == "correct_unique_max"),
             accuracy_among_evaluable = if (any(ev))
               sum(df$validation_status == "correct_unique_max") / sum(ev) else NA_real_)
}))

heldout_per_class
```

## 4. Score-depth associations

```{r score-depth}
counts <- assay(sce, "counts")
library_size <- Matrix::colSums(counts)
detected     <- Matrix::colSums(counts > 0)

assoc <- function(x, y, pair, subset) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(ok) < 5L || stats::sd(x[ok]) == 0 || stats::sd(y[ok]) == 0)
    return(data.frame(metric_pair = pair, subset = subset, n = sum(ok),
                      pearson = NA_real_, spearman = NA_real_))
  data.frame(metric_pair = pair, subset = subset, n = sum(ok),
             pearson  = stats::cor(x[ok], y[ok], method = "pearson"),
             spearman = stats::cor(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman"))
}

max_exin <- suppressWarnings(pmax(per_cell$marker_contrast_Excitatory_neurons,
                                  per_cell$marker_contrast_Inhibitory_neurons, na.rm = TRUE))

max_exin[!is.finite(max_exin)] <- NA_real_

score_depth <- rbind(
  assoc(library_size, per_cell$neuron_core_marker_contrast, "library_size~neuron_core_contrast", "all"),
  assoc(detected, per_cell$neuron_core_marker_contrast, "detected_features~neuron_core_contrast", "all"),
  assoc(library_size, max_exin, "library_size~max_exin_contrast", "all"),
  assoc(library_size, per_cell$exin_margin, "library_size~exin_margin", "all"),
  assoc(library_size, per_cell$nonneuron_top1_score, "library_size~nonneuron_top1_score", "nonneuron"),
  assoc(library_size, per_cell$nonneuron_score_margin, "library_size~nonneuron_score_margin", "nonneuron"),
  assoc(library_size, per_cell$nonneuron_predicted_detection_fraction,
        "library_size~nonneuron_detection_fraction", "nonneuron"))

score_depth
```

## 5. Reference agreement (SingleR)

Reference labels are mapped to broad classes. Genes matching `^MT-`, `^RPL`
or `^RPS` are removed from both the query and the reference. Labels are pruned at 3 MADs, and the pruned label is used as the reference call.

```{r broad-labels}

broad_label_groups <- list(
  Excitatory_neurons = c("Glut", "Glutamatergic", "Superficial_layer_glutamatergic",
    "Deep_layer_glutamatergic", "L2/3 IT", "L4 IT", "L6 CT", "L5 IT", "L6 IT", "L6 IT Car3",
    "L5ET", "L6b", "L5/6 NP", "L5 ET"),
  Inhibitory_neurons = c("PVALB", "SST", "LAMP5", "PAX6", "VIP", "GABAergic",
    "caudal ganglionic eminence derived interneuron",
    "medial ganglionic eminence derived interneuron", "MGE", "CGE"),
  Endothelial = c("Endothelial", "endothelial cell"),
  Pericytes = c("Fibroblast_pericyte", "VLMC", "fibroblast", "pericyte"),
  Microglia = c("CNS_macrophage", "Microglia", "central nervous system macrophage", "microglia"),
  Astrocytes = c("Astrocyte", "astrocyte", "Astrocytes"),
  Oligodendrocytes = c("Oligo", "Oligodendrocyte", "oligodendrocyte", "Oligodendrocytes"),
  OPCs = c("OPCs", "OPC", "oligodendrocyte precursor cell"),
  neural_progenitor = c("radial glial cell", "neural progenitor cell", "neuron", "GABAergic_NPC"),
  smooth_muscle_cell = c("vascular associated smooth muscle cell", "smooth muscle cell"))

make_broad_label <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x); out <- x; assigned <- rep(FALSE, length(x))
  for (b in names(broad_label_groups)) {
    hit <- !assigned & x %in% broad_label_groups[[b]]
    out[hit] <- b; assigned <- assigned | hit
  }
  out
}
```

```{r singler, eval = params$run_singler}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(SingleR))

run_singler <- function(name, ref) {
  obj <- readRDS(ref$path)
  if (methods::is(obj, "Seurat")) {
    if (!is.na(ref$subset_field))
      obj <- subset(obj, cells = rownames(obj@meta.data)[obj@meta.data[[ref$subset_field]] == ref$subset_value])
    obj <- Seurat::as.SingleCellExperiment(obj)
  } else if (!is.na(ref$subset_field)) {
    obj <- obj[, which(obj[[ref$subset_field]] == ref$subset_value)]
  }

  if (!("logcounts" %in% assayNames(obj)))
    obj <- scuttle::logNormCounts(obj, transform = "log", size.factors = NULL, name = "logcounts")
  common <- intersect(rownames(obj), rownames(sce))
  keep <- common[!Reduce(`|`, lapply(gene_exclude_patterns, grepl, x = common))]

  broad <- make_broad_label(obj[[ref$label_field]])
  pred <- SingleR::SingleR(test = assay(sce[keep, ], "logcounts"),
                           ref = assay(obj[keep, ], "logcounts"), labels = broad)

  pruned_flag <- SingleR::pruneScores(pred, nmads = prune_nmads)
  unpruned <- as.character(pred$labels)
  pruned <- unpruned; pruned[!is.na(pruned_flag) & pruned_flag] <- NA_character_
  status <- ifelse((!is.na(pruned_flag) & pruned_flag) | is.na(unpruned), "pruned_to_na",
            ifelse(unpruned %in% out_of_scope_labels, "reference_out_of_scope",
            ifelse(unpruned %in% canonical_classes, "mapped_pruned", "unmapped_reference_label")))
  data.frame(cell_id = colnames(sce), reference_name = name,
             ref_label_unpruned = unpruned, ref_label_pruned = pruned,
             ref_delta_next = as.numeric(pred$delta.next), reference_status = status,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

for (nm in names(references))
  save_tsv(run_singler(nm, references[[nm]]),
           file.path(paths$work_dir, "04_singler", paste0("reference_", nm, ".tsv")))
```

```{r agreement}
pred_dir <- if (isTRUE(params$run_singler)) file.path(paths$work_dir, "04_singler") else
  file.path(paths$zenodo_root, "metadata", "reference_annotations")

cohens_kappa <- function(a, b) {
  n <- length(a); if (n < 2L) return(NA_real_)
  lv <- sort(unique(c(a, b)))
  pe <- sum(as.numeric(table(factor(a, lv)) / n) * as.numeric(table(factor(b, lv)) / n))
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(pe, 1))) return(NA_real_)
  (mean(a == b) - pe) / (1 - pe)
}

per_class_directional <- function(pred, ref, classes) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(classes, function(k) {
    n_ref <- sum(ref == k); n_pred <- sum(pred == k); n_hit <- sum(ref == k & pred == k)
    recall <- precision <- f1 <- NA_real_
    if (n_ref > 0L) {
      recall <- n_hit / n_ref
      precision <- if (n_pred > 0L) n_hit / n_pred else 0
      f1 <- if (recall + precision > 0) 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) else 0
    }
    data.frame(class = k, n_reference = n_ref, n_predicted = n_pred, n_agree = n_hit,
               recall = recall, precision = precision, f1 = f1)
  }))
}

agreement <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(references), function(nm) {
  pred <- utils::read.table(file.path(pred_dir, paste0("reference_", nm, ".tsv")),
                            header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", comment.char = "",
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE, na.strings = c("NA", ""))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pred$cell_id), setequal(pred$cell_id, colnames(sce)))

  refp <- pred$ref_label_pruned[match(colnames(sce), pred$cell_id)]
  space <- !(final %in% ann_unresolved) & !is.na(refp) &
           !(refp %in% out_of_scope_labels) & refp %in% canonical_classes
  pc <- per_class_directional(final[space], refp[space], canonical_classes)
  sup <- pc$n_reference > 0L

  data.frame(reference_name = nm, total_query_cells = length(final),
             n_in_agreement_space = sum(space),
             all_cells_agreement = mean(final == ifelse(is.na(refp), "pruned_NA", refp)),
             restricted_agreement = mean(final[space] == refp[space]),
             cohens_kappa = cohens_kappa(final[space], refp[space]),
             macro_recall = mean(pc$recall[sup]), macro_precision = mean(pc$precision[sup]),
             macro_f1 = mean(pc$f1[sup]))
}))
agreement
```
